description: Default COST finding bounds in technical units (bytes, counts). Never monetary amounts. Contract/pack/config may override.

scan_volume_bytes.rationale: >10 GiB scanned per execution is a dominant scan driver worth reviewing

replication_max_copies.rationale: >3 replicas is an unusual durability footprint for analytic data

materialize_min_dup.rationale: same subject materialized by >=3 distinct executions suggests consolidation

shuffle_bytes.rationale: >1 GiB of shuffle/spill per execution is a measurable I/O driver

small_file_bytes.rationale: avg file <8 MiB makes per-file overhead dominate the scan
